text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day,
while out and about with Victoire 
Pisa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Victoire Pisa pointed,
there 
was a claw crane game filled with stuffed 
plushies modeled after Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Are you interested in Paka Petits?
Are you interested in Paka Petits?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... I received one from a friend the 
other day.
choice_data_list: Are you interested in Paka Puchi?
Are you interested in Paka Puchi?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It's so lovely, just placing it there 
brightens up the whole room, but...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking that being all alone 
really is quite lonely after all...
choice_data_list: Then let's bring a friend home wit...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Huh, are you sure? Still, I can't trouble 
you like this, Trainer...
choice_data_list: Then let's bring our new friend home!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! Yes, I look forward to working with 
you!
choice_data_list: Being all alone is lonely, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
